description: Obtain Christa Müller-Kessler, Die Zauberschalentexte in der Hilprecht-Sammlung, Jena (TMH 7, Harrassowitz 2005), or at minimum authoritative bibliographic evidence identifying the series volume.
resolution_notes: Resolved 6 September 2026 from the official Library of Congress record: LCCN 2006364726 explicitly gives the series as Texte und Materialien der Frau Professor Hilprecht Collection, Bd. 7, with author, imprint, ISBN and call number. This resolves the bibliographic key only; the book was not consulted.

description: Consult Müller-Kessler 2005, TMH 7, through the Library of Congress for object-level edition indexing.
resolution_notes: Library of Congress record confirmed 6 September 2026: one copy is available onsite in General Collections under PJ5208.A5 M85 2005. The catalog resolved the publication key, but the volume still needs page-level consultation after the Reader Identification Card is obtained.

description: Consult Marco Moriggi, A Corpus of Syriac Incantation Bowls (2014), through the Library of Congress for object-level edition indexing.
resolution_notes: Library of Congress record confirmed 6 September 2026: one copy is available onsite in General Collections under PJ5615 .M665 2014. The record verifies ISBN 9789004272804; no content was consulted.

description: Consult the 1998 third edition of Naveh and Shaked, Amulets and Magic Bowls, through the Library of Congress for object-level edition indexing.
resolution_notes: Library of Congress record confirmed 6 September 2026: one copy is available onsite in General Collections under BM729.A4 N38. The separately cataloged 1985 first edition is also available onsite under LCCN 87182340, including a Hebraic Reading Room copy; do not conflate it with the corpus's 1987 second-edition source.

description: Resolve the MRLA 8 and TMH 7 publication-object-key prefixes to the publications they designate, using explicit series-volume evidence rather than inference.
resolution_notes: Resolved in two append-only registry decisions. MRLA 8 was verified from the Ford–Morgenstern volume's own imprint as SRC-8A145FAA2EBB (IBI-PUBREG-19). TMH 7 was verified from official Library of Congress LCCN 2006364726, which explicitly names Bd. 7, as SRC-63345F60155B (IBI-PUBREG-20). All 19 current publication keys now resolve; the physical volumes still have separate access leads for content inspection.
